title: Stop micromanaging your storage — pay just $359.97 for 10TB of storage during this sale
content_html:
TL;DR: Cloud storage is useful. Continuously paying for enough room to accommodate your ever-expanding pile of files? Not cool. Drime Advanced++ with 10TB of lifetime cloud storage is only $359.97 (reg. $1,299) through Oct. 11 during the Deal Days sales event.

Credit: Drime

$476.99
$1,299 Save $822.01

And this isn’t just 10TB of digital attic space.

Drime is a European cloud storage platform that combines storage with tools for sharing, editing, collaboration, and e-signatures. Files sync across your devices, and there’s no file-size limit, so giant videos and other hefty files don’t need special treatment.

For sensitive documents, Drime includes an end-to-end encrypted Vault using 256-bit AES and SSL/TLS encryption. Files are encrypted locally and remain accessible only to you. Drime is hosted in Europe, is GDPR compliant, and doesn’t route data through the U.S.

The Advanced++ plan also gives you some breathing room when mistakes happen. File versioning lasts up to 120 days, allowing you to restore an earlier version instead of dramatically mourning the document you accidentally changed.

Drime’s collaborative workspaces can organize files, projects, and clients. Built-in document and media editors let you make changes without leaving the platform, while review tools support timestamped comments on videos, PDFs, and images.

You can also request e-signatures with Drime Sign and share files using links with passwords, expiration dates, custom links, and access stats. Large videos get adaptive playback, fast scrubbing, and previews.

In other words, you’re not buying 10TB just to watch it fill up.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Get Drime Advanced++ with 10TB of lifetime cloud storage for $359.97 (reg. $1,299) through Oct. 11 during this Deal Days sale.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
